item.title: Do you have a voice for radio? – CCFM
item.description: Do you have a voice for radio? If so, CCFM is hosting a presenter search on Saturday 12 November starting at 9am in the CCFM Hall. 146 Main Road, Muizenberg. Registration is required and previous presenter experience will be advantageous. Find the registration link on our Instagram and Facebook pages.
